metadata.description: Standards bypass configuration for this branch

bypass.reason: Test file — lives in tests/, not in the 3-layer apps/ structure by design

Shared-instance shim pattern — module-level names are bound-method re-exports from JsonHandler, not constants. Lowercase is correct for callable bindings (PEP 8). The naming checker exempts imports and call-assignments but not attribute aliases, so it reads them as non-UPPER_CASE constants. Matches the identical bypass carried by spawn, memory and canary for this identical file; shipped here so a newborn does not have to rediscover it.

notes.usage: Add entries to bypass specific seedgo standard violations
